Armor Toughness does not reduce damage in this formula. Its only job is to blunt Armor Shred and Armor Pierce used against you: 2% per point, up to 60% at 30 toughness. Mobs rarely have either, so for a player toughness is almost dead weight.

Armor sets: score = output bonus × effective healthk, the damage you deal times how long you last. Effective health uses Apothic Attributes' armor rule (damage × a/(a + armor), a = 10 for hits under 20, 10 + (hit − 20)/2 above) against the attack damage of the Keeper that ends the Act (10 at Act 0, 30 at Act VI, 50 at Act XII), on top of 20 + 4 HP per Act from your other gear, × damage-taken reduction and dodge. Toughness only blunts armor shred in this pack, so it counts little. k = 1 for Melee, 0.7 Ranged, 0.6 Mage and Summon (fighting at range, you take fewer hits). Output bonus: Melee attack damage (flat bonus against the Act's typical weapon hit), attack speed, crit, lifesteal; Ranged arrow damage, draw speed, crit; Mage: the better of Iron's (spell power + the best single school, × cast rate from cooldown reduction, × mana: +300 mana = +25%) and Ars Nouveau (flat spell damage against the Act's typical hit, × mana); Summon summon damage and +25% per extra minion slot. A plain set is the fallback in every list; a set built for the role beats it. Sets whose armor is computed in code get the median of their Act.
